blocks.text: The reversal comes suddenly when The Singhs suddenly pounced upon them unawares, attacking before the Mughal camp can fully gather itself into a disciplined defense.

As the Singhs made a sudden rush into the fort, they seized whatever advantage appeared, including the horses which were standing harnessed and saddled, and turned the enemy’s own preparation into panic.

Reinforcements fare no better, for the Khalsa Singhs shredded them as well until the surviving leaders conclude that they must flee and take refuge in the village, leaving backers like Murtaza Khan and Haji Babar Beg exposed to ruin.
